comparisons.interpretation: Lopez gives an affirmative single-payer plan eliminating patient charges and rejects a means-tested public option as sufficient. Torres also supports a version of single payer but explicitly conditions support on labor buy-in and preserving Bronx healthcare jobs and funding. This is a difference in stated conditions, not evidence that Torres opposes single payer.
Both explicitly support healthcare access for undocumented residents. The agreement does not remove their distinct statements about single-payer conditions.
Both support supervised consumption sites. Torres's short affirmative response is scoped to the actual consumption-site question, not every other yes in the questionnaire.
Both support sex-work decriminalization. Lopez discusses a package of measures for transgender women of color; Torres answers a question that also names a proposed H.R.1865 amendment.
